dialogue.speaker: James
dialogue.text: Good evening. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Good evening. I have a complaint about my room.

dialogue.speaker: James
dialogue.text: I am sorry to hear that. What is the problem?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: The air conditioning is broken, and the room next door is very noisy.

dialogue.speaker: James
dialogue.text: I apologize. I will send someone to fix the air conditioning right away.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you, but I asked for a quiet room when I booked.

dialogue.speaker: James
dialogue.text: You are right. Let me check if we have another room available.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: If not, I would like to speak to the manager.

dialogue.speaker: James
dialogue.text: I understand. We have a quiet room on the fourth floor.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Good. And could I have a refund for tonight because of the trouble?

dialogue.speaker: James
dialogue.text: I can give you a twenty percent discount. Would that be acceptable?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, that is fair. Thank you for solving the problem.
